posts.text:
The White House SHOULD be preparing for oversight investigations. We are going to have tough questions and subpoenas.

Oversight Democrats are committed to investigating Epstein and Trump family corruption, and we won't stop until we get the truth.

Video

We are committed to accountability and the truth. Whether it’s Kristi Noem, Pam Bondi, or Stephen Miller, Oversight Democrats are going to take on EVERY instance of corruption in this Administration.

We will get answers.

Video

Our Epstein investigation has always been about centering the survivors. Next week, Oversight Democrats are hosting a hearing in Palm Beach to hear directly from them. We won’t stop fighting until we get the truth.

Video

After filing contempt charges against Pam Bondi, Oversight Republicans finally announced a date to question the former AG. Now, we are demanding that the interview is videotaped and released to the American people. That’s a decision only the majority can make. No more cover-ups.

While we’re spending billions on Trump’s illegal war, gas prices are through the roof and families are struggling. We need to end this war now and focus on making things affordable for American families.

Video

Proud to have founded the Popular Arts Caucus and to have hosted our 3rd Free Comics Day in the Capitol!

Thank you to the Library of Congress, participating stores, and everyone who stopped by our event this week. Comics power the economy.

Video

Trump and his family are making themselves richer off the backs of the American people as working class people struggle. We are investigating the grift and won’t stop until we get real accountability.

Video

After avoiding us for weeks, it only took 45 minutes for Pam Bondi to schedule her hearing in front of our Committee, once we filed contempt charges.

She's going to face some tough questions. We're fighting for survivors, and we're not going to stop until we get justice.

Video

📣 Today is the annual FREE COMIC BOOK DAY at the Capitol. Come by our Cannon 109 office from 9:30am to 11:30am for free comic books and rare finds from the Library of Congress.

Celebrate the Popular Arts and National Free Comics Day together. 💥🦸🏽

After we put the pressure on her by filing contempt charges today, Pam Bondi finally scheduled her hearing before the Oversight Committee. 

We look forward to seeing her — but if she skips out, we’re holding her in contempt.

Video

The Supreme Court's decision to attack the Voting Rights Act is a real threat to representation and our democracy. Congress must pass legislation to restore the protections of the VRA and ensure fair representation in government.

45 minutes after we filed contempt charges against Pam Bondi for illegally defying our subpoena, Oversight Republicans finally announce a date for her testimony.

Survivors deserve justice, and we will do whatever it takes to get to the truth.

Video
Release the Epstein files! And Bondi must testify! #congressman #dems #epstein #pambondi
We just filed for re-election to Congress!
Abolish ICE. #congressman #democrats #dems #abolishice
It’s a White House Cover-Up. #democrats #congressman #dems #oversightcommittee #releasethefiles
ICE is terrorizing LA. All people have a right to due process. #democrats #congressman #dems
NO MORE OIL DRILLING off our coast. #democrats #congressman #dems
We won’t stop until we RELEASE the Epstein files! #democrats #congressman
Time to stop this Epstein cover-up.
Release the Epstein Files, NOW. #democrats #congressman #dems
Let’s fucking go.
